scope: Final CSS resource/performance audit plus authorized village fog palette and actor-anchored stamina-warning updates. No browser or device timing.
protectedTextHashNormalization: CRLF normalized to LF before SHA-256 and baseline comparison
limitations: No FPS improvement or zero-cost claim; browser compositing, offscreen surface allocation and mobile GPU time were not measured.
This report excludes pre-existing untracked preparation artifacts and generated catalogs; tracked runtime resource/source hashes are compared to the baseline.

finalCssFindings.filterScope: Only the five existing small icon ::before pseudo-elements. Normal state uses one 1px drop-shadow; keyboard focus replaces it with one 2px shadow on the focused icon, without animation.

performanceAssessment.expectedCost: Small bounded browser icon paint/filter work plus a bounded active-warning projection/update. Net timing relative to removed boxes is not measured.
performanceAssessment.gameResources: No new game WebGL textures, materials, geometry, LODs or decoded source assets. The21 remaining protected source/manifest hashes match the baseline; main.js, the new warning helper and world.js are separately authorized changes.
performanceAssessment.browserResources: CSS filters may use small browser-managed intermediate raster/compositing surfaces. Their exact allocation, caching and CPU/GPU cost are not measured.
performanceAssessment.fps: The existing FPS text updates approximately twice per second; its single text-shadow repaints with text changes. No new timer or frame work.
performanceAssessment.warning: The warning retains one text-shadow and gains one actor-height projection only while active, using the existing HUD frame. No new scheduler, timer, listener or animated bone update; existing four-second toast timer remains authoritative.

authorizedAtmosphereChange.scope: Village-only existing engine-fog color at initial scene creation and map replacement. Actual sky color, forest/cave/plains palettes and plains boundary interpolation remain unchanged.

files.scope: Existing toast/show/timer/reset and projected-HUD integration for actor-anchored stamina notice.
One reusable Vector3 plus warning state; no owned clock, listener, animation frame or cooldown.

perFrameWork.inactiveOrDisposed: Immediate return before projection; zero warning projections.
perFrameWork.visibleWarning: One additional use of the existing ScreenProjection.project() after the existing beginFrame(); uses upright actor height, with no animated head-bone traversal.
perFrameWork.hiddenOrInvalid: Zero projections when the warning is inactive or fails visibility/actor/projection validation; valid pending warnings project once before being revealed.
perFrameWork.allocation: Reuses Vector3 and ScreenProjection result; visible updates still form small validation arrays and CSS coordinate strings. The main call supplies an options object. No zero-allocation claim.
perFrameWork.domWrites: CSS coordinate variables update only when their string values change. Canvas offsets are read in the existing resize/layout callback, not per warning frame.

authorizedWarningAnchorChange.lifecycle: Reset on ordinary-toast replacement, timeout, death/restart, character load, map change and pagehide; disposed during departure.
